newsitem.title: UK: AMP plans bid for UKs Norwich Union.
newsitem.headline: AMP plans bid for UKs Norwich Union.

text.p: Life insurer Australian Mutual Provident Society (AMP) is planning a takeover bid for Norwich Union after the British insurance group floats on the London stock market next month, Saturday's Times newspaper said.
The newspaper said AMP was working with merchant bank Morgan Stanley and planned to make a bid shortly after Norwich Union's flotation on June 16.
AMP recently lost a battle to win control of mutually-owned insurance group Scottish Amicable when its offer was trumped by Britain's Prudential Corp Plc.
After its bid for Scottish Amicable failed, AMP said it was interested in a number of other acquisition opportunities in Britain.
